headline: DGT Says 38 Steel Companies Suspected of Tax Evasion Have Been Processed
summary: Indonesia's Director General of Taxes said 38 of 40 steel companies indicated as not complying with tax rules have been processed. The statement was made by Bimo Wijayanto of the Finance Ministry.
why: Steel is a core industrial input, and tax enforcement against producers affects sector costs and regulatory risk in Indonesia's market.
